info.title: finwire.pl - Public financial data API
info.description: Open API: NBP rates, WIBOR/POLSTR, CPI inflation, FX rates, 10-year bond yields, flat transaction prices (RCN, GUS), rents and rental yield, GUS wages, government bonds, macro calendar and finwire indicators (credit stress map, barometers). Cite as: Source: finwire.pl, https://public-api.finwire.pl
